text.aria-label: Title text 'How far the forecast median follows a step in the lags'

g.text: How far the forecast median follows a step in the lags

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Interim, four folds. A step of 5% of effective capacity is added to the power lags of clean forecast rows, k of them: k=1 the origin lag, k=2 also the same-time-yesterday lag, k=3 also the same-time-last- week lag (steps up and down both counted, oriented so a forecast that follows the step scores +1; 0: ignores it). One column per lead band. Solid: lagged form; dashed: lagless form, which has no lags and so stays flat at 0.'
text.tspan: Interim, four folds. A step of 5% of effective capacity is added to the power lags of clean forecast
rows, k of them: k=1 the origin lag, k=2 also the same-time-yesterday lag, k=3 also the same-time-last-
week lag (steps up and down both counted, oriented so a forecast that follows the step scores +1; 0:
ignores it). One column per lead band. Solid: lagged form; dashed: lagless form, which has no lags and so
